version: V7.3 final 56mm datum spacing, actual IMU rear relief
renderer: Blender4.3.2 Cycles64 samples, original CAD STL meshes only. No imagegen or invented product geometry. Neutral stage, lighting, camera and material assignments added.
annotations: Actual CAD projections plus Chinese labels composited by Pillow; no product geometry altered by annotations. Orange solder-tail meshes are explicit unmeasured assumptions, not actual material/color claims.
qualification_zh: ②ELF2 PCB前表面Y54.70至④相机腹板后表面Y110.70，由用户要求驱动为56.00mm。模型风扇组件→整架最短15.241062955mm为校核结果，不再将15mm硬设为目标；到加强筋26.399mm为3D最短距离。IMU背焊脚3mm、锡半径1mm/高1.3mm均是假设；保守整排包络到腹板1.61mm、到pad2.5mm，不是实物安全裕度或绝缘认证。无整体抬高IMU，腹板和0.3mm垫片同步真实避让，M2支承保留。冷靴可换杆由用户确认，9mm露牙非采购总长，新鞋外形/头部仍待实测。非加工放行。

Only outside local presentation bounds cropped; contact faces/relief surfaces not hidden, tails not sectioned. Manifest names26 presentation meshes; not additional manufacturing parts.
